## Design

### 2026-09-30 — since it was my first time using KiCad, i had a bit of trouble making the schematic. but, I got used to it quickly!

**3h**

since it was my first time using KiCad, i had a bit of trouble making the schematic. but, I got used to it quickly!

so basically, this has nine leds, three buttons, and one 1-digit seven segment display. i am planning to make a binary timer, a memory game, and a reaction game for now. i can think of other features later.

I was also researching the parts (my lookout only captures KiCad, I had to pause the recording) and looking at data sheet and double checking what to wire

for the PCB,
